newsitem.title: UK: Topps Tiles seeks market listing, eyes expansion.
newsitem.headline: Topps Tiles seeks market listing, eyes expansion.

text.p: Topps Tiles Plc, the UK specialist tile retailer, said on Wednesday it is seeking a full listing on the London Stock Exchange.
The company is expected to have a market capitalisation of over 20 million stg at the start of dealings.
Topps Tiles operates 54 retail outlets and said it intends to double the number of outlets over the next three years.

The company said in a statement that it has achieved continued growth in turnover and consistent profitability since its foundation in 1984. Its sales in the 53 weeks ended June 1, 1996 totalled 22 million stg, turning a pre-tax profit of two million stg in that period.

Topps Tiles said it aimed to become the leading retail brand in the UK tile market which market research for the industry estimates to be worth approximately 160 million stg and is forecast to grow by 21 per cent in the next four years.
